response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount >= 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY p.avg_amount DESC

assumptions.assumption: The blank purpose code is stored as a value (empty string or whitespace) in order.k_symbol, not NULL, so GROUP BY keeps it as its own group; it is not trimmed or merged with other values.
The overall figure is the simple (unweighted) mean of the per-purpose averages, as the request states, not the mean of all qualifying orders.
'At least 2802' means amount >= 2802 inclusive, applied before computing any averages.
